environment.implementation: existing project encryptors; local in-memory; no external services

measurement_method.encryption_wall_and_cpu: encrypt API return, including key setup, nonce generation, serialization and BLAKE2b digest creation
measurement_method.decryption_wall_and_cpu: base64 decoding, BLAKE2b verification and authenticated decryption of all layers
measurement_method.throughput: input plaintext MiB divided by corresponding measured wall time
measurement_method.ciphertext_expansion: raw nonce plus ciphertext and GCM tag bytes, minus plaintext bytes; excludes base64, JSON metadata, digest, and provider metadata
measurement_method.memory: peak tracemalloc allocation from separate encryption and decryption probes; excluded from timed values; not RSS
measurement_method.p95: empirical nearest percentile reported only for groups with at least 30 successful samples; small-sample p95 is suppressed
measurement_method.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals for encryption and decryption medians; deterministic seed, 2000 resamples
measurement_method.failures: each measured operation is retained with status and exception class; no exception messages or secrets are recorded

interpretation.high_vs_single_aes: High uses two independent ECDH/HKDF-derived AES-GCM layers; the baseline uses one random AES-256-GCM key. Both share the same process and application trust boundary. The benchmark measures overhead, not security advantage.
interpretation.memory: Python traced allocations only, not total process RSS
